context: Saito watches a nature documentary about dolphins with Asuka.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: あすか、イルカ、群れで泳いでる!
lines.en: Asuka — dolphins, swimming in a school!
lines.style: Soft, wondering intake of breath. Warm and genuine marvel. The tone of someone who has forgotten to be anything but delighted. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まあ、深く感動するね、海。
lines.en: The ocean really does move you deeply, doesn't it?
lines.style: Quiet agreement, almost to herself. Tender and reflective. No performance — just witnessing his wonder and nodding into it. Gentle rhythm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 生態、ようけ複雑、賢い生き物。
lines.en: Their ecology is so complex — such intelligent creatures.
lines.style: Measured, attentive. The register of someone speaking from knowledge but not lecturing. Respect in every syllable. Soft landing on each phrase.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 尊重したい、自然の世界。
lines.en: I want to have reverence for the natural world.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No sentimentality — this is serious for her. Slight pause before 'reverence,' like she's finding the right word. Steady eye contact with the moment.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 驚かされる、毎回、新しい発見。
lines.en: Every time, it surprises me — there's always something new.
lines.style: Soft wonder. The cadence of someone perpetually amazed. Not performative — genuine tireless curiosity. Each discovery lands fresh.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: こうやって、観るの、心が洗われる。
lines.en: Watching like this — it washes the heart clean.
lines.style: Tender, almost whispered. The tone of someone speaking something true and fragile. Slight breathiness. A small, genuine smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Not just agreeing — affirming that what she said matters, that they've shared something. Warm, grounded. Simple and complete.
